FN-25PMIKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 250
Committee: Economic Development and Tourism Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/26/2024
House Bill 250as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Environmental Management (ADEM) by an undetermined amount to administer a recycle credit
program; however, this increase in obligations could be offset, wholly or in part, by registration
fees, established by ADEM under provisions of this bill, and civil penalties, up to
$1,000 for each violation, to be allocated as follows: 1) 40% to the Solid Waste Program, 2)
40% to the Recycle Credits Program, and 3) 20% to the Recycling Fund.
Further, this bill will decrease receipts to the Alabama Recycling Fund, Solid Waste Fund, and
ADEM by an undetermined amount dependent upon the value of recycle credits paid to offset
solid waste disposal fees, as provided by this bill.
